exercises.title: Use a blocked landing
exercises.instruction: Move the right-hand white man to a destination Black cannot capture.

feedback.initial: Test Black's landing after each candidate move.
feedback.selected: Compare both legal destinations of the right-hand man.
feedback.success: White's teammate occupies the square Black would need to land on. The moved man cannot be jumped.
feedback.goalMiss: Move the right-hand man where its teammate blocks Black's landing. The other destination allows an immediate capture.

exercises.title: Choose the covered side
exercises.instruction: Move Black's man nearest the center to a destination White cannot capture.

feedback.initial: Find the black man nearest the center, then compare its two steps.
feedback.selected: One destination has a teammate blocking White's landing.
feedback.success: Black's teammate denies White the landing beyond the moved piece.
feedback.goalMiss: Use the specified black man and keep White's landing covered. That choice does not meet the defensive goal.

exercises.title: Respect a king
exercises.instruction: Move Black's king to any destination the white king cannot capture immediately.

feedback.initial: Check every diagonal of the opponent's king.
feedback.selected: Three steps are safe; one gives White an immediate jump.
feedback.success: Your destination avoids an immediate king capture. More than one safe move can satisfy the goal.
feedback.goalMiss: White's king can jump your king there. Choose another legal destination.

exercises.title: Use a backward escape
exercises.instruction: Move White's edge king backward to avoid Black's jump.

feedback.initial: The forward step enters a jump. A king has a backward escape as well.
feedback.selected: Compare both directions and keep the king safe.
feedback.success: White used the king's backward step to improve a cramped position without losing material.
feedback.goalMiss: Black can capture the king on that forward square. Use its backward escape.

exercises.title: Captures come first
exercises.instruction: Watch Black expose a man, then make White's compulsory capture.

feedback.opening: Black steps next to White's king and leaves its man capturable.
feedback.initial: Look for captures before comparing ordinary destinations.
feedback.success: White exploited the move you watched, taking a man without allowing an immediate recapture.
feedback.invalidDestination: A capture is compulsory. Choose its landing.
